title: plugin-approvals: past the 1000-row suspended-run page, a revise-window recall on a batch item cannot find its batch run and leaves it parked
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d13k5TVyAhqhiKKgN3

Filing gate: out-of-scope finding of the #28183 dev (os-dev report 6529875250), source PR #28228, filed at seat 4's request. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: any batch approval flow (a `map` over approval items, e.g. `showcase_release_signoff` → `one_task_signoff`) on a deployment whose durable suspended-run store (`ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore`) holds more than 1000 `paused` rows, when a submitter recalls a batch item from its revise window.
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-automation` for the engine member, `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals` for the caller).

## What the code does (read, not measured)

PR #28228 makes the revise-window recall wake the batch: after `cancelRun` on the item's run, `ApprovalService.resumeBatchOfRecalledItem` (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`) finds the batch run as the entry of `listSuspendedRunsDurable()` whose `correlation` is `map:<itemRunId>`, then resumes it. `listSuspendedRunsDurable` is the deployment-wide listing (`readSuspendedRuns('degrade')` in `service-automation/src/run-history.ts`), which a DB-backed store serves from `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore.list()`: one page, `limit: 1000`, in driver order. Past 1000 parked runs the batch run may not be on that page. The lookup then finds nothing, and the recall answers exactly as it did before PR #28228: the batch stays parked on the cancelled item, and nothing tells the caller (`resumeError` stays empty, nothing is logged).

## Wanted (route is triage's)

A precise lookup instead of a page scan. The item run's own suspension context already carries its batch: `map-node.ts` launches each item with `$parentRunId` (and `$parentMapNode`). The fix this finding proposes: an engine member in `engine.ts` / `run-resume.ts` that answers the batch run for an item run id from the item's `$parentRunId` (read before or by `cancelRun`, since `cancelRun` forgets the item's suspension row), declared on `ApprovalResumeSurface` and called by the recall in place of the `listSuspendedRunsDurable` scan. Measure first: a store with more than 1000 `paused` rows where the batch run is past the page.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `listSuspendedRunsDurable`, `1000`, suspended-run page, recall + batch, `$parentRunId`: none. **New.**

Links back: #28183, PR #28228, PR #28176, #27971

Blocked-by: #28228
